methods.label: Divide the numerator by 4
methods.levelReason: The requested numerator uses elementary table division; the fraction equality uses the Grade 5 basic property of fractions.

candidate.annotationRationale: The requested output is the exact quotient 4 ÷ 4, without a prescribed calculation method. cnm_p046 stays method-local because it specifies multiplication facts, supported by cnm_p043 and cnm_p039. cnm_p167 describes dividing both fraction components by the same nonzero number in the accompanying equality; completing fraction reduction is not an additional assessed output. needsNewNodes.name: Evaluating exact whole-number quotients
needsNewNodes.description: Evaluate the whole-number quotient of a nonnegative whole-number dividend by a positive whole-number divisor when the dividend is a multiple of the divisor, without prescribing a calculation method.
needsNewNodes.reason: cnm_p046 specifies a multiplication-fact method rather than the requested quotient alone. The division-meaning and written-division nodes also do not precisely cover this route-neutral calculation target.

limitations: The assessed target has no suitable catalog ID and remains pending catalog addition.
candidate.changeReason: 4 ÷ 4 gives the requested numerator 1, and 8 ÷ 4 gives denominator 2. The explanation is correct and sufficient, so retain it verbatim while repairing only the assessed annotation and reporting the missing target.

review.mathematicalCheck: \(4\div4=1\) gives the requested numerator. Also, \(8\div4=2\); dividing both components by the same nonzero number establishes \(4/8=1/2\). The short explanation is sufficient.
review.levelCheck: Table division and the basic property of fractions are within Grade 5.
